tools.name: tapgoods_list_rentals
tools.description: List rentals (quotes, reservations, and orders) for the business, with customers, status, dates and totals. Filter by status, location, customer, name or date range. Read only. GraphQL: getRentals.

tools.name: tapgoods_get_rental
tools.description: Get one rental by its id or token, with customers, location, products and totals. Read only. GraphQL: getRentalById.

tools.name: tapgoods_list_products
tools.description: List rental products for the business or for given locations, with prices and quantities. Filter by search text or ids. Read only. GraphQL: getProducts.

tools.name: tapgoods_list_inventory
tools.description: List inventory items at one location, with the quantity held for each product, bundle, accessory or add-on. Read only. GraphQL: getInventories.

tools.name: tapgoods_get_location
tools.description: Get one location's details: name, status, contact email, locale and location code. Read only. GraphQL: getLocationDetails.

tools.name: tapgoods_list_pick_list_statuses
tools.description: List the pick list statuses of one location, for checking items out and in. Read only. GraphQL: getPickListStatuses.

tools.name: tapgoods_find_locations_with_availability
tools.description: Find locations within a radius of a point that have enough inventory for the items and dates given. Read only. GraphQL: getLocationsWithAvailableInventory.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tapgoods_get_location · Private data: tapgoods_get_rental, tapgoods_get_location · Public sink: tapgoods_get_location.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tapgoods_get_location · Private data: tapgoods_get_rental, tapgoods_get_location · Public sink: tapgoods_get_location

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
